Select nuclear rDNA contigs from a barrnap scan

Source: R/find_rrna.R
select_rrna_contigs.Rd

Given the merged barrnap GFF for one sample's supplied assembly, keep the contigs that carry a nuclear rDNA anchor. A contig qualifies on an 18S or a 28S hit; a lone 5.8S hit does not, because 5.8S is short enough that a single hit is as likely to be a degraded pseudogene copy as a real repeat unit.

Usage

select_rrna_contigs(gff_lines, lengths = NULL, max_contigs = 10)

Arguments

gff_lines

Character vector, the merged barrnap GFF.

lengths

Optional named numeric of contig lengths, names = contig ids.

max_contigs

Most contigs to keep, best first (default 10). Fed from the sample's assemble_opts.max_scaffolds, which is also the gate load_assemblies() applies afterwards.

Value

list with candidates (contig ids, best first) and evidence (one row per contig scored: contig, length, rrna_features, rrna_bases, rank, selected, reason)

Details

Only contigs barrnap hit at all are scored, so the evidence returned is the handful of rRNA-bearing contigs rather than every contig in a draft genome.
